purpose: Weekly check of the public GitHub repos the owner said to watch: changes, crash and security items, Windows builds, course fit.
triggers: weekly check up on the repos

model.notes: no model needed for the check; the plain-words report is written by the session

owner_approval: scheduling a weekly task (the owner sets it up)
evaluation: check prints a per-repo diff against the last snapshot and saves its state file; due exits 0 after 7 days else 1; status prints the last summary; no credential is read or stored.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Python stdlib only; same command on the box.
